notes: Ground tiles abut with NO joint: geometry must land EXACTLY on the cell plane on all four edges, unlike buildings which stop short of it. A tile 5 cm short shows a crack the length of a street.
Paving slabs are boxes, not chamfered octagons -- a chamfer would open a hole where four tiles meet.
Carriageway is 20 m, matching mf-modular-road-v1 and the 20 m gate clearances in the building and superstructure kits.
Every edge socket declares mf_edge_z so a placer never butts a grade tile against the low side of a terrace edge.

runtimeIntegration.note: Nothing registered in boot.js or manifest.json.
